translations.title: Trimebutine Maleate 150 mg Tablet
translations.efficacy: This medicine is used for acid reflux and hiatal hernia; for the digestive problems that come with gastritis, duodenitis or ulcers — stomach pain, indigestion, nausea and vomiting; and for irritable bowel syndrome and spastic colon.
translations.usage: Adults take 100–200 mg three times a day, before meals. The dose may be adjusted to suit your age and symptoms.
translations.caution: Do not take this if you have an inherited problem with lactose metabolism, such as galactose intolerance. Talk to a pharmacist before taking it if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Get advice if your symptoms last a long time or get worse.
